title: Need help with my main title screen menu rpg maker mz

posts.author: spades141
posts.body: So im using a plug in to let me change the main title screen. And I love it but I cant seem to figure out how to customize the menu its self. I saw a few plug ins but idk much about codes and a lot of it is confusing. So here i am asking for your help once again. This first screen shot is what I have currently. And I have the new game continue and options as "Choice options" and each choice does what it needs to do. How do I move it and change the font? Here is an example of what I would like in the second picture. Im sure i have to use a plug in but I need help finding one and how to use it. This main title screen is my first plug in and its pretty simple. Just make a map set the map in the plug in and boom done. But I can only move the choice to the left, center, or right bc thats what the default choices are for mz. Can anyone help and explain to me how to do it. Like im 10 lol thanks. Im slowly learning the ropes and my first game is for my kids and my d&d group.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
You'd make a menu using the show choice command or event something with the show picture command instead.
@hiddenone
has a tutorial on how to do picture menus that should still old up
https://www.rpgmakerweb.com/blog/eventing-a-picture-based-menu
